messages:
maria: quick pass on the Vector Preview modal — found a handful of keyboard + copy + accessibility nits when testing batch preview + rerank flows. putting them here for visibility :eyes: kevin: thanks mari — can you list the high priority ones? we want to include any copy tweaks in tomorrow's patch. tara: fyi I ran the preview on a large batch and saw layout shift when the right pane loads vectors, might be related to image placeholders. maria: prioritized: 1) keyboard focus order: toolbar actions (Export, Filter, Copy IDs) are not reachable via keyboard before the preview list. focus lands in the table and you can't get back to toolbar without mouse. 2) export label: the primary button currently says "Download" — suggest "Export CSV" to be explicit for non-power users. 3) relevance column header says "Score" — users read this as arbitrary; change to "Relevance score (0-1)" or add tooltip. 4) visual contrast: badge text in the rerank chips fails AA on dark theme — see a11y-bot scan. oliver: re: focus order — the modal uses a single tabindex trap on the entire modal and then native tabbing inside. I think the toolbar is DOM-after the preview, so tab order follows DOM. we can reorder DOM or set tabindex="0" on toolbar controls to surface them first. a11y-bot: automated scan results: 3 color-contrast failures (badge: #6b6b6b on #ffffff), missing aria-sort on reorderable column headers, interactive elements without discernible names (icon-only copy ID). see /reports/1793004512-a11y for details. kevin: good catches. maria, can you propose exact copy? Tara, can you confirm the layout-shift repro steps so eng can reproduce? maria: copy proposals: - Export button: "Export CSV" (primary) - Export tooltip: "Exports selected vectors and metadata as CSV." - Column header: "Relevance score" and a tooltip: "Higher = more relevant; normalized 0–1." - Icon-only button: add aria-label="Copy vector IDs". tara: repro: upload 2k rows in batch input -> open first preview -> click preview for long vector (2000 dims) -> right pane fetches and resizes image placeholders -> toolbar jumps down ~36px. Happens on Chrome + Safari. oliver: thanks, I'll try to reproduce. quick frontend plan: move toolbar markup above preview list in DOM, add role="toolbar" and keyboard handlers, and set aria-labels for all icon buttons. also will add aria-live="polite" region for export result messaging so screenreader users get feedback. dev-bot: suggested code snippet for focus utility: ``` // ensure toolbar is reachable first
``` kevin: one more UX ask — when reranking is applied, users lose context of their original order. can we add a toggle: "Show original order" that persists per-session? should be small and inside the toolbar. maria: yes, add a subtle copy: "Show original order" (toggle) with accessible state and aria-pressed. if possible show a small toast: "Rerank applied — toggled to original order" with aria-live. a11y-bot: also recommend keyboard shortcut hint: "Press R to toggle rerank" exposed via the toolbar and visible in the tooltip. ensure shortcuts are documented in keyboard shortcuts modal. tara: small copy nit: in the vector details flyout the header says "Vectors" can be singular "Vector embedding" — helps with screenreader brevity. maria: agreed. final checklist for PR: - reorder DOM so toolbar is first - add role/aria-labels to toolbar + icon buttons - change copy per proposals - fix contrast for rerank chips (increase weight or adjust bg) - add aria-sort to sortable headers - aria-live feedback for export + rerank toggle - small perf fix to placeholder images to prevent layout jump (skeleton with fixed height) oliver: I'll take the DOM + aria changes. moving to a branch now, will ping when ready for review. kevin: thanks all — @maria can you drop the exact copy strings into the design file and update the Figma component? link please. maria: added to figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/embeddings-preview-v2 — comments on frames: "Toolbar copy", "Export CTA", "Relevance tooltip". kevin: perfect. priority: include accessibility and copy changes in the next patch. leaving a :thumbsup: here. maria: thanks! will follow up if anything else comes up during testing.
